Human Tech Blog Skill v1.0.0 – Initial Release

- Generates technical blog articles that read authentically human, eliminating AI-sounding habits.
- Strictly avoids mechanical structures, formulaic phrasing, overuse of bullets, and forced summaries.
- Encourages first-person, experience-based, and conversational writing—includes real opinions, uncertainty, and practical code examples.
- Adapts style for Chinese and English blogs, respecting their distinct conventions.
- Provides clear anti-patterns, recommended practices, self-checklists, and scenario-specific writing tips.
